summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser as specified. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases plus non-node and graph-immutability tests. The new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the shared venv. Only these two new files are in the working tree; nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so type-check and formatting gates were applied by reading only. Judgment call: the type-ignore for the expected-exception case sits on the parser call line inside pytest.raises, not on the with line, since that is where the checker reports the error.
